label: hand-checked annotation (ground truth for evaluation)
source: Built 2026-10-22 by the Replay agents: yolo11x person boxes (imgsz 1280, conf 0.35) at 10 Hz, a first guess per box from body colour (k-means), a vote along isolated 10 Hz box chains, then every box in an overlap at 2 Hz viewed by eye and 36 corrected (wrong person, or not a person box: a ball, an arm). Spot check: 100 random entries viewed, about 5 wrong or ambiguous, all where two people overlap. Never pipeline output, never shown in the app. Fix 2026-10-22: A added at 40.2-41.1 s (in frame next to the camera, arm out with the ball; the GT detector had missed him for those ten frames), boxes checked by eye.
